archives.integration_note: The supplied internal SHA256SUMS predated the bundled plotting script and 18 bundled PDF figures. The expanded ledger was repaired to describe the actual archive payload; the original archive is retained unchanged. The plotting script's last-resort font was then changed from unavailable Liberation Serif to Matplotlib's bundled DejaVu Serif so clean-environment reproduction does not emit repeated font warnings. Data, validation, and statistics files already matched their supplied digests.
